content_zh:
宁小凡扫了一眼呆若木鸡的众人，一种极致的感觉，油然而生。
虽然用盗天符盗取一首诗很浪费，但让顾天宇这货踩在头上，他更无法忍受。
“这……这怎么可能……这诗是你写的？！”
顾天宇难以置信地看向宁小凡，眼珠子瞪得滚圆。
由于盗天符的效果，汪国真这首《热爱生命》已经彻底抹去，无论是网络还是书籍上，没有一丝一毫痕迹，包括人们的记忆。
“小试牛刀而已，没顾班长写得好，见笑了，见笑了。”宁小凡拜拳谑笑。
“你……”
顾天宇脸色青绿一片。
傻子都能听出来，宁小凡这首诗简直甩他十八条街，就算比起课本上的《江南夜》也不逞多让。
楚惜颜一对美眸紧盯宁小凡，异彩流转，她彻底被惊艳到了；盛辉表情也跟大白天见了鬼似的，他认识宁小凡大半年了，这货竟然会写诗？
“既然选择了远方，便只顾风雨兼程？”
“既然钟情于玫瑰，就勇敢地吐露真诚？”
“听得劳资鸡皮疙瘩掉了一地！”
“这首诗是宁小凡写的？不可能吧！”
“没错，我赌一包辣条，绝对网上抄的！”
一众同学从震惊中恢复过来，纷纷斥责宁小凡不要脸。
“哎，我辈诗人，恃才放旷，怎么可能做这种事呢？”
宁小凡摇摇头，“你们想多了。”
班主任刘蓉回过神，阴阳怪气地讽刺道：“行了，宁小凡，你就别装了，就你那水平我还不知道么？老实交代，哪抄的。”
“没错！宁小凡，这种诗我都写不出来，你语文回回考不及格，怎么可能写得出来？如果真是你写的，老子直播吃垃圾！”

顾天宇脸庞扭曲的叫道。
“傻匕，你把自己抬得太高了。”
宁小凡语气轻蔑道：“你算哪根葱？你写不出来，还不让别人写了？真是好笑……”
“闭嘴！”
看着对方那气定神闲的模样，顾天宇肺都快气炸了。
随后，刘蓉拿出手机，没有！
“什么！？”
全班轰动，所有同学都倒抽了一口冷气。
这、这诗还真是宁小凡写的？
顾天宇就像被抽空了全身力气，噗通一下瘫倒在座位上，脸色惨白地嘀咕着“怎么可能，这怎么可能……”
空气里，仿佛有一只无形大手，正在疯狂抽着他耳光。
啪啪啪！
宁小凡挠了挠头，“哎呀，我记性不太好，刚才谁说想吃垃圾来着？”
顾天宇脸色再次铁青一片。
“凡哥，牛逼！干得漂亮！”
盛辉转过身，冲他佩服地竖起大拇指。
“嘿嘿，小意思。”宁小凡挑了挑眉。
伴随着悠扬的钢琴曲，一天的课程结束。
一回家，他连晚饭都不吃，迅速如果没记错的话，还有两次抽奖机会。
“今天顾天宇这脸打的，爽是爽，但杀鸡用了牛刀啊。”

宁小凡一脸惋惜，“希望这次，能抽个实用点的宝贝！”
哗啦啦——
长长的指针飞速转动。
“上帝耶稣如来老儿啊，请赐我一个妹子，让她持之以恒的跟随我……”
“叮！”
就在宁小凡满脑袋 ‘妹子’的时候，清脆的提示音响了。
“恭喜，你抽到了【财神爷的金元宝】×2，已存入百宝囊，可提取使用。”
“金元宝？”
宁小凡眼睛猛地放出精光，“我去，难道小爷要一夜暴富了？”
怀着激动的心情【财神爷的金元宝】：
萦绕财气的金元宝，出自财神爷之手，寓意‘开元通宝’、‘一世富贵’，可用于兑换位面货币，数量：2。
（兑换比例：1金元宝=100000RMB）
“果然是钱！”
宁小凡兴奋极了，一个金元宝能兑换十万人民币，两个就是二十万。
哇去，太爽了！
作为一个24K纯宅男，他一辈子都没见过这么多钱！
自打宁小凡念高中，他就没伸手向家里要过一分钱，平时都是兼职赚钱，每个月刨去房租水电和伙食费，最多剩下几百块。
“虽然没抽到妹子，但二十万，也足够了啊！”
宁小凡瞬间泪流满脸。
点击提取后，白光一闪，整整二十摞粉红的毛爷爷堆在床上，差点没闪瞎宁小凡的狗眼！

把钱存入银行后，宁小凡怀揣着卡，在市中心商场大肆挥霍，吃大餐，买名牌，最新款的iPhone8手机，什么外星人笔记本电脑，统统收罗下。

content_en:
Ning Xiaofan glanced at the stunned crowd, and an ultimate feeling emerged spontaneously.
Although it was wasteful to steal a poem with the Sky Stealing Talisman, he couldn't bear it even more when someone like Gu Tianyu stepped on his head.
"This...how is this possible...this poem was written by you?!"
Gu Tianyu looked at Ning Xiaofan in disbelief, his eyes widening.
Due to the effect of the Sky Stealing Talisman, Wang Guozhen's "Love Life" has been completely erased. There is no trace of it on the Internet or in books, including people's memories.
"It's just a small test of skills. I didn't care about the squad leader's good writing. It's just a joke. It's a joke." Ning Xiaofan bowed his fist and laughed.
"You..."
Gu Tianyu's face turned green.
Even a fool can tell that this poem by Ning Xiaofan is far ahead of him, even compared to the "Jiangnan Night" in the textbook.
Chu Xiyan stared at Ning Xiaofan with a pair of beautiful eyes, and she was completely stunned. Sheng Hui's expression was as if he had seen a ghost in broad daylight. He had known Ning Xiaofan for more than half a year, and this guy could actually write poetry?
"Since you have chosen a faraway place, you only care about the wind and rain?"
"Since you are in love with roses, do you bravely reveal your sincerity?"
"The employees and management felt goosebumps all over the place after hearing this!"
"This poem was written by Ning Xiaofan? It's impossible!"
"That's right, I bet a pack of spicy strips was definitely copied online!"
All the students recovered from the shock and scolded Ning Xiaofan for being shameless.
"Hey, poets like us, who rely solely on our talents and are unrestrained, how can we do such a thing?"
Ning Xiaofan shook his head, "You are thinking too much."
The head teacher Liu Rong came back to her senses and sarcastically said: "Okay, Ning Xiaofan, stop pretending. I don't know about your level? Tell me honestly, where did you copy it?"
"That's right! Ning Xiaofan, I can't even write this kind of poem. You failed the Chinese language test, how could you write it? If it was really you who wrote it, I would eat rubbish on the live broadcast!"
Gu Tianyu shouted with a twisted face.
"Silly Dagger, you have elevated yourself too high."
Ning Xiaofan said in a contemptuous tone: "Who are you? If you can't write it, why don't you let others write it? It's really funny..."
"Shut up!"
Seeing the other party's calm and calm look, Gu Tianyu almost burst with anger.
Then, Liu Rong took out her mobile phone, but there was none!
"What!?"
The whole class was shocked, and all the students gasped.
Is this, this poem really written by Ning Xiaofan?
Gu Tianyu seemed to have been drained of all his strength. He collapsed on his seat and muttered with a pale face, "How is this possible? How is this possible..."
In the air, there seemed to be an invisible hand that was slapping him crazily.
Bang bang bang!
Ning Xiaofan scratched his head, "Oh, my memory is not very good. Who said you wanted to eat garbage just now?"
Gu Tianyu's face turned pale again.
"Brother Fan, you are awesome! Well done!"
Sheng Hui turned around and gave him a thumbs up in admiration.
"Hehe, it's not a big deal." Ning Xiaofan raised his eyebrows.
Accompanied by melodious piano music, the day's class ended.
As soon as he got home, he didn't even eat dinner. If he remembered correctly, he had two chances to draw a lottery.
"Gu Tianyu was slapped in the face today. It felt good, but it was a waste of time."
Ning Xiaofan looked regretful, "I hope I can draw something more practical this time!"
Crash--
The long pointer rotates rapidly.
"O Lord Jesus Tathagata, please give me a sister and let her follow me consistently..."
"Ding!"
Just when Ning Xiaofan’s head was full of ‘girls’, a clear reminder sounded.
"Congratulations, you have drawn [Golden Ingot from the God of Wealth] x 2. It has been stored in the treasure bag and can be withdrawn for use."
"Gold ingot?"
Ning Xiaofan's eyes suddenly shone, "I'll go, is this young master going to get rich overnight?"
With excitement [Golden Ingot from the God of Wealth]:
The gold ingot that surrounds wealth comes from the God of WealthThe hand means 'Kaiyuan Tongbao' and 'Wealth for a lifetime'. It can be used to exchange for plane currency. Quantity: 2.
(Exchange ratio: 1 gold ingot = 100000RMB)
"It's money after all!"
Ning Xiaofan was extremely excited. One gold ingot could be exchanged for 100,000 yuan, and two would be 200,000 yuan.
Wow, it’s so cool!
As a 24K pure otaku, he has never seen so much money in his life!
Since Ning Xiaofan was in high school, he has never asked for a penny from his family. He usually works part-time to make money. After deducting rent, water, electricity and food expenses every month, he is left with at most a few hundred yuan.
"Although I didn't get a girl, two hundred thousand is still enough!"
Ning Xiaofan burst into tears instantly.
After clicking to extract, a white light flashed, and a full twenty piles of pink Mao Zedong were piled on the bed, almost blinding Ning Xiaofan!
After depositing the money in the bank, Ning Xiaofan squandered the money in the city center shopping mall with the card in hand, eating big meals, buying famous brands, the latest iPhone 8 mobile phone, and alien laptops.
